notes: REF-BM-04: title/description/tags/note editable, but url field is hidden in edit mode (urlStep hidden) so url cannot be edited via UI though backend supports it. REF-BM-05: no DELETE endpoint and no delete UI action anywhere. REF-BM-10: existing tags offered as a checkbox checklist, not as typeahead autocomplete on entry. REF-BM-12: searchMatch only searches title/description/notes, url is not included. REF-BM-14: '#tag' is treated as a literal word against text fields, no tag-search syntax. REF-BM-15: search only splits on whitespace with implicit AND; no OR/NOT/parentheses/quoting-of-operators. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase handling; whitespace-split only. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-scoped whole-collection action. REF-BM-22: list is hardcoded to createdAt-desc; no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: notes stored and shown as plain text (white-space:pre-wrap), no markdown rendering. REF-BM-24: no local HTML snapshot and no PDF handling. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-27: archive is reversible (restore), but no permanent delete exists to distinguish it from. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (sort, items-per-page, font size).
